title: TUTORING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS TO BE DOMAIN-ADAPTIVE, PRECISE AND SAFE
reasoning: The thesis focuses extensively on evaluating and ensuring the safety and ethical rigor of LLMs. It introduces benchmarks like TechHazardQA and HarmEval to test ethically sensitive queries and evaluates cultural and multilingual safety. Furthermore, its cultural safety dataset explicitly includes 'Religion' and 'Ethics' as core categories, detailing and benchmarking model responses to religious conflicts, misrepresentations, and moral dilemmas across various global cultures.
